query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                                AS total_completed,
  SUM(archivedPdfUrl IS NOT NULL)                         AS archived,
  SUM(archivedPdfUrl IS NULL AND aiReportUrl IS NOT NULL) AS still_missing_with_pdf,
  SUM(archivedPdfUrl IS NULL AND aiReportUrl IS NULL)     AS missing_no_pdf
FROM consultations
WHERE status = 'completed';
